text:
mira: quick follow-up from the sync. I'm proposing a bridgeless handoff gateway (BHG) as a minimal, per-AZ mediator that replaces persistent tenant sidecars for hosted routing. key goals: minimal blast radius, opt-out for private installs, clear teardown semantics for mid-stream evictions. feedback?

hao: like the name. main worry is telemetry/bleed between hosted and private. how do we opt private installs out without touching manifests?

mira: default is no manifest change required for private installs. we expose a tiny optional flag in runtime.handoff so vendors can explicitly set `use_bhg: never`. control-plane global org settings can also force skip for private clouds.

tess: makes sense. perf: we need two modes: tunnel (negotiate then TCP tunnel) and proxy (full app proxy for audit). default to tunnel for streaming. call out latency budgets in RFC.

omar: teardown: when runtime preempts mid-stream, clients flake. propose a small structured eviction frame: STREAM_EVICT {token:"<opaque>", reason:"quota"}. SDK retries with token if supported. token must be PoP-signed and single-use.

mira: agreed. token lifecycle: <=60s TTL, signed by runtime, validated by control-plane. BHG only passes token; it must never persist it.

tess: billing attribution even with tunnel is important. handshake should carry a billing_tag so runtime attributes cost correctly. sample manifest draft (optional):

```json
{"runtime":{"handoff":{"prefer":["bhg","direct"],"max_ttl_s":120,"billing_tag":"hosted:small"}}}
```

omar: failure modes: if BHG is down, SDKs should try pinned direct runtime when present. hosted non-pinned tenants fall back to control-plane proxy and possibly a cheaper model variant. BHG should expose a circuit-breaker metric so SDKs can detect and fallback.

hao: security controls: mTLS bhg->runtime, PoP short-lived client tokens against BHG, replay-detection telemetry, and ban persistent storage of payloads on BHG nodes.

infra-bot: infra checklist: https://infra/tasks/bhg-canary  includes per-AZ canary, mTLS cert rotation, feature-flag gate, telemetry dashboard, and privacy audit steps.

mira: tests to run: 1) tunnel vs direct latency, 2) STREAM_EVICT resume+reconnect, 3) opt-out correctness for private installs, 4) token replay attempts blocked, 5) privacy audit proving no stream persistence. I'll author the RFC with diagrams and SLOs (tunnel extra median <= 4ms).

tess: one more: consider opt-in dual-write hedging for a small set of high-SLA tenants (standby runtime replicate) as a paid feature; document costs.

omar: agreed. add hedging as opt-in with explicit billing_tag. Mira, ping when RFC is up; I'll review the eviction/resume token spec.

mira: thanks all
